# Employee Survey Data

## 1. Load and Explore the Data

```{r}

# Load the employee survey Data
Survey_Data <- read.csv("~/Downloads/Typical_Employee_Survey_Data.csv")

# Assign column names
names(Survey_Data) <- c("Age", "Gender", "JobSatisfaction", "ImportantChar", 
                        "YearsWorked", "PromotionLikely", "DecisionMaking", 
                        "BudgetDecision", "OrgPride", "TurnDownJob", 
                        "WorkplaceRelation")

# Explore Data
head(Survey_Data)
str(Survey_Data)
dim(Survey_Data)
```

## 2. Five-Point Summary and Boxplots

### Age

```{r}
# 5-point summary and boxplots

summary(Survey_Data$Age)
boxplot(Survey_Data$Age,
        main = "Boxplot of Age",
        ylab = "Age")
```

### Years Worked

```{r}
summary(Survey_Data$YearsWorked)
boxplot(Survey_Data$YearsWorked,
        main = "Boxplot of Years Worked",
        ylab = "Years Worked")
```

### 3. Convert Variables to Factors

```{r}
# Convert variables to factors
Survey_Data$Gender <- as.factor(Survey_Data$Gender)
Survey_Data$JobSatisfaction <- as.factor(Survey_Data$JobSatisfaction)
Survey_Data$ImportantChar <- as.factor(Survey_Data$ImportantChar)
Survey_Data$PromotionLikely <- as.factor(Survey_Data$PromotionLikely)
Survey_Data$DecisionMaking <- as.factor(Survey_Data$DecisionMaking)
Survey_Data$BudgetDecision <- as.factor(Survey_Data$BudgetDecision)
Survey_Data$OrgPride <- as.factor(Survey_Data$OrgPride)
Survey_Data$TurnDownJob <- as.factor(Survey_Data$TurnDownJob)
Survey_Data$WorkplaceRelation <- as.factor(Survey_Data$WorkplaceRelation)

# Verify the data
str(Survey_Data)
```

### 4. Visualizations

```{r}
# Histogram for Age
hist(Survey_Data$Age, 
     main = "Distribution of Age", 
     xlab = "Age", 
     ylab = "Frequency")

# Barplots for Variables
barplot(table(Survey_Data$Gender),
        main = "Gender",
        xlab = "Gender",
        ylab = "Frequency")

barplot(table(Survey_Data$JobSatisfaction),
        main = "Job Satisfaction",
        xlab = "Job Satisfaction",
        ylab = "Frequency")

barplot(table(Survey_Data$ImportantChar),
        main = "Most Important Job Characteristic",
        xlab = "Characteristic",
        ylab = "Frequency")

barplot(table(Survey_Data$PromotionLikely),
        main = "Likelihood of Promotion",
        xlab = "Response",
        ylab = "Frequency")

barplot(table(Survey_Data$DecisionMaking),
        main = "Decision Making",
        xlab = "Response",
        ylab = "Frequency")

barplot(table(Survey_Data$BudgetDecision),
        main = "Budget Decision",
        xlab = "Response",
        ylab = "Frequency")

barplot(table(Survey_Data$OrgPride),
        main = "Organizational Pride",
        xlab = "Response",
        ylab = "Frequency")

barplot(table(Survey_Data$TurnDownJob),
        main = "Would Turn Down Another Job for More Pay",
        xlab = "Response",
        ylab = "Frequency")

barplot(table(Survey_Data$WorkplaceRelation),
        main = "Workplace Relations",
        xlab = "Response",
        ylab = "Frequency")

# Scatter Plots for Relationships

# Age vs. Years Worked
plot(Survey_Data$Age, as.numeric(Survey_Data$YearsWorked),
     main = "Age vs. Years Worked",
     xlab = "Age",
     ylab = "Years Worked")

# Age vs. Job Satisfaction
plot(Survey_Data$Age,
     as.numeric(Survey_Data$JobSatisfaction),
     main = "Age vs. Job Satisfaction",
     xlab = "Age",
     ylab = "Job Satisfaction")

# Years Worked vs. Promotion Likelihood
plot(Survey_Data$YearsWorked,
     as.numeric(Survey_Data$PromotionLikely),
     main = "Years Worked vs. Promotion Likelihood",
     xlab = "Years Worked",
     ylab = "Promotion Likelihood")
```
